# Module: modal-supplier.js

**Responsibility:** Supplier detail/edit modal — open, close, toggle edit mode, save (`PUT /api/suppliers/:id`), and the placeholder P.I.S.T.A. chat panel.
**Location:** `ui_design/js/controllers/database/modal-supplier.js`
**Depends on:** `state.js` (`currentData`, `API_BASE`), `renderers-master-data.js` (`renderSuppliers`, to refresh the table after save)
**Consumed by:** `databaseController.js` (side-effect import only, to register `window.*` handlers), `onclick` attributes generated by `renderers-master-data.js`

## Exports

None — all handlers are registered on `window` for use by generated HTML `onclick` attributes: `openSupplierModal`, `closeSupplierModal`, `handleSupplierModalBgClick`, `toggleSupplierEdit`, `saveSupplierModal`, `sendSupplierChat`.

## Key Concepts

- Private module state (`modalSupplier`, `supplierEditMode`) tracks which record is open and whether it's in edit mode — not shared with any other file.
- `saveSupplierModal` mutates the found record in place (`Object.assign(s, body)`) rather than replacing it, so it stays the same object reference inside `currentData` — the subsequent `renderSuppliers(currentData)` call picks up the change without a re-fetch.
- The P.I.S.T.A. chat panel is a static placeholder (`sendSupplierChat` always replies "This feature will be available soon.") — not yet wired to a real backend.

## What is NOT here

- Product/Customer/Order modals — see the sibling `modal-*.js` files
- Supplier table rendering — see `renderers-master-data.js`
